sentences.text: The evidence does not show a gold-loan-specific pre-payment penalty for this bank, and the only gold-loan document says gold loans are granted for up to 12 months.
The only bank documents stating a pre-payment charge are home-loan clauses, and they conflict because one says 2% of the principal outstanding while another says 3% of the principal outstanding.

For UCBs, the in-force directions say pre-payment charges on loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026 are subject to paragraph 261, but applicability is unknown without the sanction date and other facts.

So the pre-payment penalty on gold loans cannot be answered from the provided evidence, and the searched materials did not include a gold-loan clause stating the charge or a sanction date for the loan.

missing.searched: searched the gold-loan FAQ and the in-force UCB pre-payment directions, but found no gold-loan clause stating the charge
searched the in-force UCB pre-payment directions; applicability depends on sanction or renewal date
